title: Margin price and value funnel at arbitrary finite Ds labelings
statement: For d_psi = d_lambda = 1, conditionally centered laws (L) with scalar regularity (S), equal weights, centered empirical score rows, K >= 3: on one probability-one measurable event, simultaneously over every labeling at every N, (1) PRICE - for every kappa > 0 there is delta(kappa) > 0 with limsup_N sup{Phi_s_hat(z) : z feasible, I_hat_lambdalambda(z) >= kappa} <= v_K - delta(kappa), where sup(empty) = -infinity; since lambda_min(I_hat) <= I_hat_lambdalambda, the DS14 conditioning margin (M3) forces the same cap, and stability, optimality, selection measurability, and seeding are irrelevant; (2) FUNNEL - any feasible sequence with Phi_s_hat -> v_K has cells converging in sample measure to J*, min cell mass -> min_b w*_b > 0, and I_hat_lambdalambda, I_hat_psilambda, lambda_min -> 0, so DS15's degeneracy is value-topological; (3) FLOOR - label raw i.i.d. scores by any fixed measurable q with positive cell masses and I_q_lambdalambda > kappa, then compute information after exact sample centering: Phi_s_hat -> Phi(q), so the constrained empirical sup is asymptotically at least v*+(kappa) = sup{Phi(q) : I_q_lambdalambda > kappa} and v*+(kappa) <= v_K - delta(kappa). This neither asserts attainment nor continuity in kappa, and v*(kappa), defined instead by lambda_min(I_q) >= kappa, is only bounded above by v*+(kappa). (R) is not needed. Proof: Proposition 4 plus arbitrary-grouping rigidity using a compact tilt-codebook uniform law, and signed weighted-VC Glivenko-Cantelli over all tilted half-planes.
assumptions: d_psi = d_lambda = 1; K >= 3 = d_psi + d_lambda + 1 (centered-sample cardinality; the general mechanism is sum_b m_b = mu_hat, so a centered sample needs n_bins > dimension - commit 891bbf3)
(L) conditional centering E[S_lambda | shat] = 0 a.s.; (S) atomless efficient-score marginal with unique optimal scalar K-quantizer; E S = 0, E||S||^2 < oo, I > 0
i.i.d. equal weights; all empirical information uses centered rows S_i - S_bar; exact scores (estimated scores are P2)
the FLOOR labels raw S_i by a fixed q before centering the cell moments; applying an arbitrary discontinuous q to sample-centered rows is not claimed
feasible labelings: nonsingular binned nuisance block; the margin hypothesis is I_hat_lambdalambda >= kappa (weaker than lambda_min >= kappa)
(R) swap richness NOT assumed; imported only where DS15 conclusion (1) provides the v_K comparison point

proof_location.section: DS16. Margin price at arbitrary labelings, the value funnel, and the profiled compile verdict

role: resolves OP29's deployment half: prices every margin-certified state and extends DS15's degeneracy from global optima to all value-convergent sequences
warning: Audit-hardened: the compact tilt-codebook uniform law is load-bearing; a pointwise SLLN at a random subsequential centroid is invalid. The cap is over ALL labelings, so it neither needs nor delivers existence of margin-carrying exchange-stable sequences; that inhabitation question is OPEN-DS-STABLE-BASINS. No attainment or one-sided continuity of v*+(kappa) or v*(kappa) is proved. Class (L)+(S), d_psi = d_lambda = 1, equal weights, exact raw scores with centered empirical moments only.
